notes.text: The app now speaks Korean: pick "한국어" in Profile › Language, or let it follow your device.
Groups can now split in the South Korean won (KRW), and a group made in South Korea starts in it.
Profile's "Account and sync" now shows your User ID, which you can copy with one tap, so you can tell us who you are when you answer one of our surveys.
A photo you add to a bill now opens in Adjust photo first, so you frame the square that gets attached.
"By income" now reminds you to enter each one's net income, after taxes, and "Default split" only shows each one's percentage once an income is typed.
A group's header is cleaner: the line with the member count and the total under its name is gone. The faces show who's in, and Statistics shows the total.
Photos of a card or bank statement now say so, and suggest filling the bill in by hand, instead of saying the receipt couldn't be read.
A category in Statistics now opens All expenses with the group, the category and the period already picked, so you can search those bills too. All expenses also gained a Period filter.
In Statistics' By person, a tap beside the ring or in its middle lets go of the picked person.
